description: One quad drawn three times with EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing, under a node translated by z = 1.
notes: Instances: as is, x 0..1 y 0..1; translated by x = 5 and scaled by 2, x 5..7 y 0..2; rotated 90° about z (x, y → −y, x), then translated by y = −3, x −1..0 y −3..−2. All at z = 1.
The mesh counts once, however many instances draw it.
